mon.line: Gold's up. Tacos better sell or I'm flipping coins for rent.
WiFi's mine now. Quad's about to get a free upgrade.
Grill's hot. Don't let Mrs. West near the salsa.
Grackles already circling. This is war.

tue.line: Tortilla Cannon v0.1 loaded. Aim careful.
Silver's looking soft. Need more soft-shell sales.
Hacked the campus map. We're the new pin.
She's coming back. I can feel the handbag energy.

wed.line: King Grackle stole a napkin. Personal now.
Coin flip later. Double or nothing on lunch rush.
Bell schedule's mine. Early lunch is free real estate.
Cannon range test: three tables out.

thu.line: If she says 'y'all' one more time I quit.
Birds brought friends. Pickup's a battlefield.
Gold stack growing. Keep the line moving.
Stream raid locked. Tonight we trend.

fri.line: Final Cannon. One shot, one glory.
Profit goal or we become her pop-up interns.
Last day. Flip for the soul of the table.
Grackle King dies today. Or we do.

west.mon: Y'all think folding tables make an empire? Cute.
west.tue: My rival's already measuring this spot for her pop-up.
west.wed: Profit's looking thin, sugar. Angel money ain't free.
west.thu: Big hair, bigger checkbook. Don't disappoint me.
west.fri_win: Fine. Angel Round it is. Don't make me regret this.
west.fri_lose: Pack it up. Designer Pop-Up starts Monday. My terms.

gold_pitch: Gold never sleeps. Neither should our margins.
Stack these tacos like bars. Physical is forever.
Paper money burns. Gold and salsa last.
silver_pitch: Silver's the underdog. Just like us on this quad.
Cheap entry, big upside. Like a two-dollar soft shell.
When gold's loud, silver whispers profit.
coin_flip_offer: Heads we double the tip jar. Tails I scrub the grill.
One flip. Winner takes the next hour's tips.
Coin says destiny. You in or you broke?
coin_win: The market loves a winner. Pay up.
See? Risk is just profit with better lighting.
coin_lose: Temporary setback. Gold recovers. So will I.
Fine. Grill duty. But the thesis still holds.
Lost the flip, not the war. Next coin.

lvl1_agenda_swap: Campus agenda now lists us first. You're welcome.
Old Main events just got a taco sponsorship.
lvl2_taco_net_wifi: Free WiFi password is LoliRules. Traffic incoming.
Every phone on the quad just got our menu.
lvl3_early_bell: Bell rang early. Lunch stampede in three, two...
lvl4_stream_raid: Raid goes live in five. Chat's already hungry.
Thousand viewers just got the taco drop.
lvl5_golden_taco: Golden Taco code deployed. Only the worthy see it.
One limited drop. Screenshots in three, two...

ali: Mrs. West, the grill's fine, really, no need to hover.
Your handbag is... very close to the open flame.
I—I can handle the salsa. Please stop correcting me.
Enough, Mrs. West. Step back from my station.
matt: King Grackle, this napkin was not an invitation.
You want the scraps? Earn them. Fair fight.
Birds versus pickup. Scoreboard starts now.
Today the King falls. Tomorrow the line moves faster.
phillip: Tortilla Cannon prototype: air pressure and pure hope.
Range test successful. Table three is now armed.
Reload is the weak point. Working on a hopper.
Final version fires soft shells like destiny.
invest: Angel Round unlocked if profit goal clears.
Designer Pop-Up is the failure state. Avoid.
Mrs. West's checkbook opens only on numbers.
Daily margin is the real scoreboard.
ali_sports_rants: Mavs need a real center or this season's toast.
Cowboys defense folds like a cheap tortilla every December.
They traded Luka. I still haven't recovered. Flip that taco.
Jerry Jones still thinks 1995 is next year. Unreal.
If the Mavs tank one more time I'm switching to the Spurs.
Cowboys always start 8-2 then vanish. Classic.
Grill's hot, Mavs are cold. Perfect metaphor.
One more pick-six and I'm putting Jerry on the menu.
